name: Gun mantlets and cradles
boundary: Box castings and cradle supports; bespoke cast/lofted mantlets retain their outlines.

name: Track drive sprockets
boundary: Single/twin rims, tooth count and exactly one X-axis wheel registration.

name: Bumpers
boundary: Dimensioned steel/moulded box sections; bent tubular bars and body-integral noses remain authored.

name: Aircraft pitots
boundary: Exact endpoints; tapered probe and sleeve. Refuelling booms are not pitots.

name: Radar covers and arrays
boundary: Flat scanner/array and ellipsoid cover styles; exposed dishes remain specialised.

name: Towing jaws
boundary: Open jaws with vertical pin; tow balls and weapon pintles remain distinct.

name: Stowage baskets
boundary: Open floor, rails and stanchions; keep cargo outside the helper.

name: Engine cowlings
boundary: Authored helicopter station loops with skin, seams and fasteners; aircraft nozzle and inlet topology remains specific.

name: Light guards
boundary: Four family adapters retain optics and use one cage/foot builder.

name: Crane booms
boundary: Endpoint or box adapters retain folded pose and hydraulics; rescue winch housings remain local.

name: Dashboards
boundary: Three open ground cabs; hull-shaped marine consoles retain their shell.

name: Steering wheels
boundary: Ring, spokes and hub with caller-owned column.

name: Marine screws
boundary: Pitched blades and hub; rudders and waterjets are separate assemblies.

name: Cargo sideboards
boundary: Flat leaves and ribs; authored stake posts and open tailgate angles remain local.

name: Sensor masts
boundary: Stage dimensions and collars; heads and pan parents unchanged.

name: Gun receivers
boundary: Receiver shells and feed-cover hardware; barrels, feed boxes and sockets remain local.

name: Aircraft skid runners
boundary: Shared runner path; drone and helicopter cross-strut layouts remain local.

name: Fuel filler caps
boundary: Explicit outward normal, gasket, neck and cap grip.

name: Wire cutters
boundary: Blade profile and fasteners with original attachment axes.

name: Slat armour
boundary: Horizontal/vertical open panels; hull stand-offs stay authored.

name: Service hose reels
boundary: Wound pack, flanges and hub on three truck families.

name: Door and ramp leaves
boundary: Existing body, ramp and gear panels; preserves hardware and moving parents.

name: Turret race rings
boundary: Old ring cylinder plus splash lip and bolt circle; the turret pivot and its traverse stay with the family.

name: Sight heads
boundary: Box heads with bezelled windows, visor and optional panoramic stem; lofted, cylindrical and aircraft sensor heads stay authored.

name: Commander's cupolas
boundary: Ring, roof flange and vision-block housings at authored angles; hatches and weapon rings stay separate.

name: Reactive armour bricks
boundary: One brick per call with local +Z outward; grids, face frames and gaps stay in family helpers.

name: Rectangular hatch lids
boundary: Flat closed lids on a coaming with hinges and handle; round hatches, opening lids and yawed deck plates stay separate.

name: Bore evacuators
boundary: Tapered chamber on a Z-axis gun tube; muzzle sensors, brakes and thermal sleeves stay authored.

name: Dome lights
boundary: Round lens on a base reaching the old sphere's foot, with an explicit up axis; box lamps and light bars stay authored.

name: Navigation sidelights
boundary: Red to port, green to starboard on the shared marker housing; ship screens stay authored.

name: Coaxial gun ports
boundary: Old port cylinder's centre and length; the caller keeps the coax muzzle marker.

name: Automatic cannon
boundary: Breech to brake face with one root radius; muzzle markers may sit ahead of the brake and stay caller-owned.

name: Heavy machine guns
boundary: Receiver centre to muzzle with optional can and grips; finned DShK-pattern guns stay authored.

name: Medium machine guns
boundary: Receiver centre to muzzle with optional stock and can; size scales the cross-sections, not the length.

name: Grenade machine guns
boundary: Receiver centre to muzzle; drum or box feed at a mount-specific offset.

name: Rotary barrel clusters
boundary: Barrels, spindle, carrier and clamps along any axis; housings, motors and chutes stay authored.

name: Missile launch tubes
boundary: Z-axis tubes with collars and covers; box launchers, packed tube clusters and sideways tubes stay authored.

name: Rotor masts
boundary: Shaft, bearing housing, splines and bolted collars at authored heights; hubs, blades and rotor pivots stay in VehicleRotors.main.

name: Turbine exhausts
boundary: Open tapered shell between authored endpoints with liner, tail cone and lip; lofted suppressors and box outlets stay authored.

name: Fender sheets
boundary: Flat sheets and raked lips by rotation, with bead, bolts and inboard stays; faceted armoured arches stay authored.

name: Saddle fuel tanks
boundary: Round or box tanks hung from the frame rail; aircraft drop tanks and fender-mounted drums are different stores.

name: Rolled tarps
boundary: Rolled canvas on the old cylinder's axis with straps; draped covers and tapered boots stay separate.

name: Raked skirt bow panels
boundary: The old rotated bow box with hinges, grab handle, rounded leading corner and wear strip; plain panels use skirt; extruded fronts stay authored.

name: Track return rollers
boundary: Old disc centre, radius and width on an X axle; static, registers nothing.

name: Truck cargo beds
boundary: Deck between authored z0/z1 at the load surface, with runners, rails, posts, dropsides, headboard and tailgate; loads, canopies and lamps stay caller-owned.

name: Box bodies and their openings
boundary: Body between authored bounds; doors, shutters and ladders take a wall face centre and outward normal; shutters without a colour keep their material's own finish.

name: Box missile launchers
boundary: Old box centre and size, mouths in a grid on the -Z face; arms, elevation pivots and weapon tips stay caller-owned.

name: Air-launched missiles
boundary: Revolved body along -Z with seeker, cone or ogive nose, cached slab fins, band and rail; bombs and packed tube launchers stay authored.

name: Smoke discharger banks
boundary: Old bracket box plus the caller's tube transforms, so every family keeps its exact layout.

name: Rotor hub caps
boundary: Old cap cylinder on the rotor pivot, faceted or domed, optional second tier and bifilar arms; registers nothing.

name: Lamp units
boundary: Old housing with round or rectangular inserts, indicator and cage, rails, bar or cross guard; light bars of side-by-side lenses stay authored.

name: Engine intake faces
boundary: Old dark disc's centre and radius with an explicit facing; hub, spinner, fan blades, vanes or dust cone; lift fans and hollow ducts stay separate.

name: Pedestal gun mounts
boundary: Static plate, post and braces on the parent; swivel and yoke on the caller's head pivot. Companions gun_shield and ring_mount serve the pickups and light vehicles that carry them.

name: Roll cages and sport bars
boundary: Members as the old tubes' points; welded nodes, saddle clamps and base plates detected from the layout.

name: Bull bars and tube bumpers
boundary: Members as the old tubes' points, with base plates and optional lamp tabs.

name: Wheel-well tubs
boundary: The old dark well box, opened at one or both ends with a curved roof and rolled lip; armour flat-roofed bays stay authored.

name: Aircraft store pods
boundary: The old VmPlane.body station list with lugs, sway-brace pads and seam bands; targeting, jamming and tank presets.

name: Muzzle brakes and muzzle sensors
boundary: Ring-and-plate brake stacks on the howitzers and gunship cannons, and the bare boxes standing in for tank guns' muzzle reference sensors.

name: Vehicle cranes
boundary: The repair, ammunition and engineer cranes' slewing rings, posts, boxed booms, lift rams, sheaves and hooks, each drawn as separate boxes per truck.

name: Gun travel locks
boundary: The self-propelled guns' and rocket launcher's travel-lock struts, arms and saddles.

name: Machine-gun pintles
boundary: Turret-top machine-gun posts and cradles, including the Merkava loader's gun that floated over the roof.

name: Trim vanes
boundary: Amphibians' bow trim boards with their hinge brackets, latches and ribs.

name: Tow cables
boundary: Hull-side tow cables strung as plain cable sags or tubes, now with eyes and retaining clips.

name: Exhausts and silencers
boundary: Single exhaust pipe cylinders and box silencers under civilian cars, trucks and military trucks.

name: Air cleaners
boundary: Truck and tractor air-cleaner cans with their caps, straps and intake hoses.

name: Searchlights and light bars
boundary: Ship, boat and aircraft searchlight cylinders on their yokes, and the emergency and work light bars on vans, pickups and the tractor.

name: Crew benches
boundary: Boat thwarts, troop-bed benches and rear seats drawn as cushion boxes on plain legs.

name: Roof racks and crate stacks
boundary: Roof-rack rails and cross bars, and loads of crates and ammunition boxes stacked by hand on cargo beds.

name: Tanker and supply equipment
boundary: Fuel tankers' walkways, manholes and rails, their pump cabinets, and the gas bottles on repair trucks.

name: Helicopter landing gear
boundary: Main-gear drag tubes, struts and oleos, and tailwheel legs, braces and crowns on the gunships and utility helicopters.

name: Countermeasure dispensers
boundary: Flare and chaff boxes with their slot rows on the gunships, attack jets and the Kajman.

name: Formation lights and refuelling receptacles
boundary: Boxed formation-light strips and painted refuelling doors that sat off the curved skin.

name: Aircraft bombs
boundary: General-purpose, laser-guided and satellite-guided bombs built separately by the attack jets, fighters and bombers.

name: Chin turrets
boundary: Gunship chin-turret drums, cradles, ammunition chutes and magazines.

name: Track guards
boundary: Track shelves and mudguards drawn as long flat boxes over the tracks of tanks and tracked carriers.

name: Wishbone suspension
boundary: Upper and lower suspension arm boxes, dampers and uprights on wheeled vehicles.

name: Hydraulic rams
boundary: Recoil cylinders, elevation rams, dozer and crane lift rams drawn as single tubes.

name: Plates, crosses and stencil lettering
boundary: Number plates, red crosses and the stroke-font registration and hull numbers each family generated its own way.

name: Door levers and slide rails
boundary: Door handle stubs on armoured hulls and the helicopters' sliding-door rails.

name: Boat bow eyes and fenders
boundary: Bow towing eyes and hung fenders on boats and ships.

name: Oil and fuel drums
boundary: 200-litre drums drawn as plain cylinders with separate rim, hoop and bung parts on the T-55's rear plate, the Rebel supply truck and the HEMTT drum loads.

name: Spare-wheel carriers
boundary: Bracket boxes, bars and missing mounts under spare wheels on doors, tailgates, cab backs, platforms and beds; the wheel stays VehicleWheels.spare.
